svg.title: Simon Oakes - the stack
svg.desc: The stack I reach for, battle-tested. Linux at the core; Ansible, Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, Python, Go on the inner ring; Debian, GitHub Actions, Ubuntu, Packer, Red Hat, GitLab CI, Bash, Proxmox, Puppet, Jenkins, Nutanix, Nginx on the outer ring. The toolbox. Linux: Debian, Ubuntu, Red Hat-family systems, macOS, Windows Server, systemd; Automation: Ansible, Terraform, Packer, Puppet, Bash, PowerShell; Ci/Cd: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Nexus, SonarQube; Runtime: Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, HAProxy, Nginx; Code: Go, Python, Flask, API integrations; Network: BGP, OSPF, DNS, VLANs, NAT, WireGuard, IPsec, MikroTik, Cisco, RTBH; Services: Postfix, Dovecot, BIND, Apache, FreeRADIUS, monitoring, backup; Platforms: Proxmox, VMware, XenServer, KVM, Nutanix, NetApp, Pure Storage, Nimble; Ai: NVIDIA DGX Spark, vLLM, LiteLLM, Hugging Face, Azure OpenAI.
svg.text: Linux at the core, automation and CI around it,
and the platforms underneath, all used in production.
svg.title: Linux
